candidate.content: When searching for a cloth in a bathroom environment, inspecting dedicated hanging receptacles (handtowelholder_1, handtowelholder_2) before closed storage (cabinet_4) did not locate the target; the cloth was found inside cabinet_4 after opening it. The trajectory demonstrates that semantic-specific carriers (handtowelholders) may be empty even when present, and closed storage can contain the target cloth. Acquisition required navigating to the cabinet, opening it, and taking the cloth.
candidate.scope: ALFWorld bathroom environments where the task requires acquiring a cloth and both dedicated hanging receptacles (handtowelholders/towelholders) and closed storage (cabinets) are available. This is feasibility evidence that the cloth can reside in closed storage rather than on hanging receptacles; it does not establish a preferred or default search order.

direct_grounding.semantic_fact: Navigating to handtowelholder_1 revealed it contained nothing.
Navigating to handtowelholder_2 revealed it contained handtowel_1, not the target cloth.
Navigating to cabinet_4 showed it was closed.
cloth_1 was successfully taken from cabinet_4.

minimal_global_context: The initial observation listed available locations including handtowelholder_1, handtowelholder_2, towelholder_1, cabinet_1 through cabinet_4, countertop_1, sinkbasin_1, sinkbasin_2, garbagecan_1, toilet_1, and toiletpaperhanger_1.
